artifacts.type: Inno Setup Installer (User Mode - Final Beta Qualification)
improvements: Refactored performance import into a strictly atomic, caller-owned transaction with complete rollback safety on failure
Enforced pre-consumption validation of marks preview jobs before mutation, guaranteeing zero broken state or orphaned claims
Enforced strict Type-3 (exam_type == '3') continuous evaluation scope across discovery, preview, extraction, and persistence

Implemented defensible same-instance operation authorization for /api/v1/startup/shutdown, session disconnect, and database backup export using loopback check, origin/referer port matching, and in-memory instance tokens

Simplified student PerformanceView: elevated continuous internal assessments to a prominent, first-class workflow, removed retired official-results dropdown, and eliminated misleading unverified GPA table content
Enhanced desktop launcher clean shutdown with explicit database engine disposal to ensure SQLite WAL checkpoints finalize gracefully

artifacts.type: Inno Setup Installer (User Mode - Production Hardened Friends Beta)
improvements: Production same-origin security enforcement: restricts /api/ access strictly to the dynamically bound application origin (e.g. 127.0.0.1:<bound_port>), blocking unrelated localhost ports (e.g. 8001) and external domains
Dynamic CORS header management in LocalOriginSecurityMiddleware: attaches Access-Control-Allow-Origin dynamically strictly to verified allowed origins, preventing cross-origin token exposure
Instance token exposure closure in GET /api/v1/startup/status: enforces origin and referer verification so cross-origin contexts receive 403 Forbidden without leaking authorization tokens

Deterministic Exit UX in frontend/src/App.tsx: verifies shutdown response status, handles authorization failures gracefully, and polls loopback status until port release is confirmed before advising browser closure
Local storage optimization: removed obsolete beta.1, beta.2, and beta.3 installers and cleared packaging build caches, reclaiming 272.12 MB of local disk space
Expanded negative security tests in test_launcher_and_shutdown.py covering origin isolation, dev mode switching, OPTIONS preflight, dynamic port binding, and Referer verification

Downgrade prevention warning to prevent accidental schema incompatibilities

Interactive Maintenance & Storage Reset Utility (AttendPlan-Maintenance.cmd / .ps1) with SQLite integrity checks, immediate backups, and cache cleanup
CLI maintenance flags on AttendPlan.exe (--check-db, --backup-db <dest>) for zero-dependency local troubleshooting
Safe runtime switching in Launch-AttendPlan.ps1 with conflict diagnosis, active sync job protection, and explicit user confirmation
Settings recovery state machine in FirstRunOnboarding.tsx distinguishing loading, saved_found, empty, and unavailable states with verified read-back
Sanitized unauthenticated /health endpoint removing raw personal filesystem paths and surfacing database_status: 'connected'

artifacts.type: Inno Setup Installer (User Mode - Installer Data-Safety & Maintenance Correction)
